articles.title: Corero Network Security Appoints Michelle Ragusa-McBain as Vice President of Channel Sales
articles.mainIdea: Corero Network Security Appoints Michelle Ragusa-McBain as Vice President of Channel Sales
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Corero Network Security Appoints Michelle Ragusa-McBain as Vice President of Channel Sales. Corero Network Security (AIM: CNS) (OTCQX: DDOSF), a recognized leader in DDoS protection and champion of adaptive, real-time service availability, today announced the appointment of Michelle Ragusa-McBain as Global Channel Chief, Vice President of Channel Sales. Ragusa-McBain will lead Corero's global channel strategy, accelerating partner-led growth and expanding the company's go-to-market ecosystem worldwide. Related tickers mentioned: DDOSF.

articles.mainIdea: Is It Time To Reassess Cisco Systems (CSCO) After Its Recent Share Price Pullback
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Is It Time To Reassess Cisco Systems (CSCO) After Its Recent Share Price Pullback. If you are wondering whether Cisco Systems at around US$74.72 still offers value after its strong run, you are not alone. The stock is down 3.0% over the last week and 5.2% over the last month, while returns sit at a 1.7% decline year to date, 29.3% over 1 year, 65.3% over 3 years, and 90.4% over 5 years. Recent headlines around Cisco have focused on its position as a major networking and security player and how that fits into long term demand for connectivity and cloud infrastructure...
